Children’s Day Special Buns
By: Usha Chowdhary Gupta
Published: Saturday, November 13, 2010 - 7:57pm

Ingredients




5 Small Burger Buns,
8 tablespoons Baked Beans,
3 tablespoons Onion (Cut),
3 tablespoons  Chilly Sauce,
2 tablespoons Tomato Sauce,
3 tablespoons Sugar, 
1 teaspoon  Oil,
Salt and Pepper pd to taste

Preparation

1 Slit the burger buns into half, 2 Apply butter, put in a pre heated oven at  3  150 Degrees for 4-5 minutes. Check and 4 Take them out. 5 Put a pan to heat add the oil, cut onion and 6 Stir. Now add the baked beans, chilly sauce, 7 Tomato sauce, sugar and salt , pepper pd to 8 Taste. Put the baked beans on the buns and 9 Top with grated cheese. Again put them in the 10 Oven for few minutes untill cheese melts.
